name: Symphonic Noise
description: A generative wall of orchestral-style sound for study or art. Slow-shifting chords, layered voices, never loops.

name: Drum Machine
description: A 16-step drum sequencer with five synthesized voices and a drive/fold/crush distortion chain.

name: The Sound of Functions
description: Generates random mathematical functions, draws each as an animated glowing graph, and turns it into sound.

name: One-Thumb Racer
description: Drive with just your thumb. Drag anywhere in the pad to steer, long-press for nitro.

name: Tilt Pipe Quest
description: Tilt your device to guide balls through neon pipes into the goal zone. Five handcrafted levels, touch-joystick fallback included.

name: Threes Minimal
description: A minimalist sliding-tile merge puzzle — combine matching tiles and chase a new high score.

name: Maisie Eats Everything 2
description: Grow a hungry rainbow unicorn by eating everything smaller than you across ten whimsical levels.
